site.name: Beacon OSINT Tools
site.tagline: Spotlight tools to focus narrowly and deeply on selected target accounts.

tools.name: X Account Spotlight
tools.blurb: X Account Spotlight collects and analyzes an X account’s posts to uncover activity patterns, interactions, recurring themes, and language worth closer review.

tools.name: Telegram Spotlight
tools.blurb: Telegram Spotlight collects channel posts by date and keyword, then maps connections and reveals patterns across conversations.

tools.name: Bluesky Spotlight
tools.blurb: Bluesky Spotlight downloads one account’s full public post history, then shows who that account interacts with, when it posts, and what it writes about.

tools.name: TikTok Spotlight
tools.blurb: TikTok Spotlight collects selected public TikTok posts, transcribes their audio, and uses AI to explore topics, mentions, view counts, and comment themes.

tools.name: Domain Recon
tools.blurb: Domain Recon does a deep dive into the registration details and technical infrastructure of a specific domain in order to surface hidden clues.

tools.name: Coordinated X Replies Spotlight
tools.blurb: Coordinated Replies Spotlight uncovers patterns of potential coordination by tracing repeat commenters, reply timing, shared narratives, and reused images across X threads.

tools.name: Crypto Spotlight
tools.blurb: Crypto Spotlight traces crypto wallet activity and fund flows to show how money moved.

tools.name: Paste Site Spotlight
tools.blurb: Paste Site Spotlight searches paste sites and leak sources, including GitHub and more with optional API keys, for an email, domain, username, or keyword, and shows a status for each source.

tools.name: Selector Spotlight
tools.blurb: Selector Spotlight searches a username across hundreds of sites, ranks hits as Verified, Likely, or manual check, and adds deep links plus an AI assessment.

tools.name: Email Header & Phishing Analyzer
tools.blurb: Email Header & Phishing Analyzer reads a pasted or uploaded email, traces the sending path, checks SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, and extracts IPs, domains, and URLs.

tools.name: HK Vetting
tools.blurb: Vet Hong Kong finance candidates: SFC licences, court cases, sanctions, adverse media in English and Chinese.
